privacyText: Kuarto keeps everything only on this phone. There are no accounts, servers or ads, and the app doesn't send your data to anyone. It only goes online to check for a new version and, if you sign in with Google, to upload your encrypted backup.
Your data only leaves the phone when you create a backup, export a file or turn on the cloud backup. Backups are encrypted with your password: in the cloud nobody can read them, not even Google.
The permissions it asks for are to show you reminders, unlock with your fingerprint, save backups or files on the phone and install new versions.
If you delete the app without a backup, your data is lost: nobody else has a copy.

Details: {detail}

1_0_15: On new installs, "Hide in recent apps" comes turned on: nobody sees your balances in the recent apps list and screenshots are blocked. Change it in Settings › Security and privacy.
The automatic backup password is now kept in Android's secure storage and no longer travels inside backups. If you restore a backup, enter it again.
Extra protection when opening backups and downloading updates.
1_0_14: Home shows how much you owe on your cards and what's left available after paying them.
Correcting an account balance now leaves a visible "Adjustment" in Transactions, which you can delete.
The card alert says "overdue" once the payment date has passed.
1_0_13: Mic button to dictate: tap the mic in "New entry", say "spent 500 on gas" and the form fills itself.
"Can I afford it?" now answers first with this month's money and, below, counting your whole net worth.
1_0_12: Can I afford it?: type a price and Kuarto tells you if it fits, how much you'd have per day and, if not, when you get paid.
Your month in 30 seconds: a card recap of last month that you can share without showing amounts.
Log faster: type or say "spent 500 on gas" and the form fills itself.
1_0_11: When typing a password or PIN, tap the eye to see it.
Clearer texts across the app, and categories translated when your phone is in another language.
The tour now shows that you can save your backup to the cloud.
1_0_10: New animated welcome and first questions that set up your accounts, salary, recurring items, debts and goals.
Renewed tour: an example in each section and, at the end, how to back up your data.
Colors: choose a palette (Ocean, Teal, Fuchsia, Graphite) or your own color, in light and dark.
Transactions › ⋯ › Copy from another month: bring last month's expenses into this one in one tap.
Import from Excel or CSV, with a template, error review and undo.
Daily or weekly automatic backup, and you choose how many to keep. Your current data is saved before restoring.
The app is now ready for several languages: choose yours in Settings › Appearance.
1_0_9: Settings is now organized in sections: Appearance, Money, Recurring and reminders, Data and backup, Account, Security, Help and About.
Tap the magnifier in Settings to find an option by name.
1_0_8: After each update you'll see what changed here. Also in Settings › What's new in this version.
Color fixes in dark mode: calendar, pickers and help sheets.
1_0_7: Cloud backup: sign in with Google in Settings › Your data and your weekly backup is saved encrypted in your account.
If you change phones, use "Restore from the cloud" to get your data back.
1_0_6: Light or dark mode: choose it in Settings › Appearance.
Debts: with "Move the installment to Recurring", paying the installment in Recurring lowers the debt's balance.
1_0_5: "Check for updates" now appears separate from Privacy in Settings.
1_0_4: The app updates itself: it lets you know when there's a new version.
Backups, the CSV and PDFs are saved in your phone's Documents/Kuarto.
